notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR5: RECEIVE returns serially the next message or portion from the queue the CD names; with fewer levels named "the MCS determines the next message or portion", and afterwards data-name-1 through data-name-4 "will contain the symbolic names of all the levels of the queue structure". MessageControlSession#Receive serves first a held remainder that PendingReceive#Answers the named prefix, else MessageStoreState#TakeFromQueue / McsTables#TakeQueueMessage takes the first message at or under the prefix, and #Transfer writes the found path via CommunicationArea#SetQueuePath. Probes at --std 85: Q alone over Q/A/X, Q/A/Y, Q/B returns Q/A/X with the levels filled, Q+B returns B1, the partial X remainder answers next, then Q/A/Y, then NO DATA; the witness returns FIRST, SECOND, NO DATA.

next.reason: 1985: "the input CD area must contain, in the content of data-name-1, the name of a symbolic queue"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry; the 2023 RECEIVE rules cover only CONTINUE and message length, with no CD.". 2023 has no CD entry or queue hierarchy. Its RECEIVE uses data-name-2 for message length, not sub-queue names, so the CD-based queue selection rule is gone.
